name: My Only Sunshine
source: Once every millennium, Sun holds a huge gathering of the planetary spirits. While Sun has found herself down in the dumps recently -- including a relationship with Terra (Earth) that is on the rocks and what she now considers a largely mundane, solitary existence -- she hopes that the get together will brighten things up. However, after Terra ruins her event with his reckless behavior, Sun decides it's time to play the field and chooses a new planetary partner.
translation: 每隔一千年，太阳便会召集行星精灵举行盛大聚会。太阳最近情绪低落，与地球的关系也陷入危机，还觉得自己的生活平凡孤独；她希望聚会能让一切明朗起来。然而，地球鲁莽的行为毁掉了活动，太阳决定另寻伴侣，选择新的行星对象。
